name: verify-skill-supply-chain
description: Vets and continuously verifies the integrity and provenance of agent skills installed with qvr. Use when a user cares about skill security, trust, signing, tampering, or supply-chain integrity — e.g. "scan this skill for problems", "is this skill safe", "verify the skill hasn't drifted", "who is allowed to author this registry's skills", "check the signature", or "gate CI on skill integrity". Covers qvr scan, lock verify (--fail-on, --repair), trust pin/verify, and provenance.
